content.comment_body: Hello, I'm looking to create a program that will ramp up the analog output at a specified time and ramp it down at another set time. It would be helpful to adjust the ramp timing directly from the display.

Is this what you mean? With the display, you can configure: the day of the week for operation, the start and stop times, and adjust how quickly the ramp changes — increasing the value will speed up the ramp rate.
Exactly, that's what I wanted. Thanks!
Hi, I made some changes to the ixo65 program so that it ramps down at the specified time as requested. BR; [user_name]
Hello, I am unable to open the file. Do you know why this might be happening? I am using [product_name] V7.

You mentioned this issue in another topic today. The problem is your [product_name] software version is outdated. You need version V8.0 or later. The latest available version is 8.2.1, and the upgrade is free. It can be downloaded from [url]. The package is about 1.3 GB. After downloading, run the installation as an administrator.

analysis.insight_summary: Discussion focused on programming ramped analog outputs according to schedule, with flexibility to modify ramp parameters through the display. Users encountered usability issues mostly related to compatibility between different versions of the software, resulting in confusion when older versions could not open newer project files.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect easy scheduling and control of analog output ramps, ideally with the ability to adjust ramp parameters from the product display. They also anticipate that shared project files will be compatible across different software versions.
